data.one_liner: Recognize user activity on Android and iOS platforms.
data.what_it_does: Recognizes user physical activity on Android and iOS using native platform APIs (ActivityRecognitionClient and CMMotionActivityManager). Provides permission handling and a real-time activity stream.
use_when: You need to detect user movement types like walking, running, or vehicle transport.
You are building fitness, tracking, or location-aware apps on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You do not need native activity recognition capabilities.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific configuration and permissions setup
Background usage requires an additional foreground task plugin
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and NSMotionUsageDescription to Info.plist.
